name: Alpenblumengarten Kitzbüheler Horn
kurzbeschreibung: The Alpine Flower Garden on the Kitzbüheler Horn at 1,880 m: over 400 rare high-alpine plants from all over the world on 20,000 m² of panoramic terrain.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Alpine Flower Garden on the Kitzbüheler Horn is a true gem for nature lovers and botany enthusiasts. Located at an altitude of 1,880 meters, it hosts over 400 different alpine plant species from all over the world. From majestic rhododendrons to rare edelweiss varieties, this garden offers a fascinating diversity of flora that can be admired in its natural environment. It is not only a place of beauty but also an important center for the protection and research of alpine plants. A visit promises unforgettable impressions and deep insights into the alpine plant world.

Route & Requirements

The Alpine Flower Garden is easily accessible by the Hornbahn cable car, whose mountain station is located directly next to the garden. From there, a well-maintained and signposted circular path leads through the various sections of the garden. The paths are mostly barrier-free, making them suitable for families with strollers or people with limited mobility. The walking time for the entire circuit is about 1 to 1.5 hours, depending on how much time you take for the individual plants and the breathtaking views. Sturdy footwear is recommended, even though the paths are well-prepared.

Visit & Arrival

The best way to reach the Kitzbüheler Horn is via the Hornbahn, which starts directly from Kitzbühel. The valley station is well signposted and has ample parking. Alternatively, you can also arrive by bus, as the "Kitzbühel Hornbahn" stop is directly in front of the valley station. The operating hours of the Hornbahn are seasonal, so it is advisable to check them in advance. The Alpine Flower Garden is usually open from June to October, depending on snow conditions and weather. A visit in the morning or late afternoon often offers the best light and fewer crowds.

Tips

Take enough time to enjoy the beauty and diversity of the plants at your leisure. Binoculars can be helpful for observing the surrounding mountain world and wildlife. Don't forget your camera, as the photo opportunities are endless. Above the garden is the Gipfelhaus Kitzbüheler Horn, which invites you to a cozy stop with regional specialties and offers spectacular panoramic views. Inform yourself in advance about the current weather conditions, as the weather in the mountains can change quickly. A visit to the Alpine Flower Garden can be wonderfully combined with a hike on the Kitzbüheler Horn.
preis: Garden entrance free; mountain railway return ticket adults approx. €35.00, children approx. €17.50
oeffnungszeiten: End of May to beginning of Nov daily 08:30–17:00 (parallel to Hornbahn operating hours)
